title: Local backup and restore support

friendly_description: Create a stable versioned backup payload that includes snapshot history and other important local state so export and restore can share one contract.

friendly_description: Add a local restore flow that reads the versioned backup payload and replaces the supported local state so users can recover or migrate their setup.

title: Backup validation and compatibility-safe restore handling
user_value: prevent malformed or incompatible backup files from corrupting local state during restore
proposed_solution: add validation, compatibility checks, and migration-safe restore guards for the full backup payload so restore failures stay readable and non-destructive

friendly_summary: Validate backup files and fail safely during restore.
friendly_description: Add compatibility and validation guards so malformed or unsupported backup files do not corrupt local state during restore.
